body.text: Skin Changer on [Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/fortnite-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Fortnite.
Skin Changer overview

Skin Changer on [Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/fortnite-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Fortnite.
Effects are client-side—lobby teammates see your real inventory; you see the cosmetic swap on your screen.
Unlock All vs Elite Skin Changer
Unlock All is cosmetic-only—browse, favorite, export loadouts. Elite bundles Skin Changer with aimbot, ESP wallhack, and bots.
Pick Unlock All if you only want visuals; pick Elite if you Ranked with full automation. Feature overview: [cheats features guide](/blog/fortnite-cheats-features-guide/).
Browse and preview workflow
Open the Skin Changer tab in your portal, search player name, select outfit or exclusive set, apply to local client. Use effect customizer for particle intensity.
Save favorites per player for quick swap before demo sessions or content recording. Loadouts export for backup across PCs via cloud sync on Elite.
Stream and content notes
Local skins appear on your display—stream capture may still show them depending on setup. Enable [stream-proof mode](/blog/fortnite-stream-proof-setup/) for ESP and script overlays.
Test cosmetic capture separately in a 30-second OBS clip before long streams. Radar hack camera does not affect skin particles.
EAC and safety
Cosmetic modules carry the same third-party risk as any fortnite cheat—read fnhacks.org status before use. Unlock All does not grant Epic locker items; it only changes local preview.
No marketplace or trade impact—cosmetics are visual-only on your client. Pair with [EAC checklist](/blog/eac-patch-day-checklist/) after patches.
ranked with cosmetics
Elite operators run Skin Changer alongside aimbot—cosmetic tab separate from Ranked preset. Do not swap skins mid-fight; apply in fountain or strategy screen.
Compare [Elite tier guide](/blog/fortnite-elite-tier-guide/) if buying Elite primarily for Skin Changer plus bots.
